instruction: get Rogue into the back room

target.reason: Rogue cannot be moved: the Act combobox only offers the currently selected actor glitch, and depart is only offered through the exit of the actor's own room; no verb takes another person as a movable target, so no sequence of listed actions can place rogue in back-room.
